content: Hermes pre_llm_call injects a context string into the user message, never the system prompt. Official hooks docs pass session_id, task_id, turn_id, user_message, conversation_history, is_first_turn, model, platform, parent_session_id, and sender_id. Hook errors are isolated. post_tool_call and on_session_end returns are ignored. Plugins bundle skills via ctx.register_skill, loaded as skill_view(plugin:skill). ctx.call_mcp is capability-gated, synchronous, and can stall the caller. Plugin hook_callback_timeout defaults to 30s for timeout-bounded observers and pre_tool_call; a hung pre_llm_call subprocess stalls the turn unless the plugin times itself out.
